# `scripts/post-process/wan_proxy.py`

Source: [wan_proxy.py](../../../../scripts/post-process/wan_proxy.py)

HTTP proxy that emulates a wide-area link for parquet\_http\_test.py: each request waits RTT seconds before it is
forwarded (one round trip), and the response is sent at most BW bytes/s. Range and HEAD requests pass through.
Connection set-up (TCP/TLS handshakes) is not emulated, so real links are somewhat slower for few, small requests.

usage: wan\_proxy.py &lt;listen port&gt; &lt;upstream base URL&gt; &lt;rtt s&gt; &lt;bandwidth MB/s&gt;

## Contents

- [`class H`](#class-h) - HTTP proxy to `UP` that adds `RTT` seconds per request (simulates a wide-area link).
- [`class S`](#class-s) - Threaded HTTP server (daemon threads, address reuse).
